senses.en: (fml.) make sth. publicly known, esp. after it has been kept secret
examples: The spokesman of the company refused to [[disclose]] more details of their latest project to the press.

senses.en: (old ~ ) (infml. not polite) an offensive word for an old man
happening or existing in many places, and therefore not special or unusual
examples: With the improvement of people's living standard, foreign travels have become [[commonplace]].

senses.en: a thing that replaces sth, esp. because the first thing is old, broken, etc.
examples: Just two months ago, he underwent hip [[replacement]] surgery that cost $120,000.

senses.en: officially get rid of a law, system, practice, etc.
examples: It was only at the very end of the 19th century that this practice was [[abolished]].

senses.en: stop sth. from being active, either temporarily or permanently
examples: We have decided to [[suspend]] all production at the factory until safety checks can be carried out.

senses.en: sb. who believes that good things will happen
examples: He's an eternal [[optimist]]. He always expects good things to happen or things to be successful.

senses.zh: 延长，拉长，拖长（感觉或活动）
senses.en: deliberately make sth. such as a feeling or an activity last longer
examples: Doctors say these new drugs can reduce pain and [[prolong]] life for two or three years.

senses.en: (only before noun) existing now, and needing to be dealt with quickly
examples: Let's try and solve the most [[immediate]] problems before they get worse.
If the eyes are affected by the drug, you must seek [[immediate]] medical attention.

senses.en: happening or done at once and without delay
examples: Let's try and solve the most [[immediate]] problems before they get worse.
If the eyes are affected by the drug, you must seek [[immediate]] medical attention.

senses.en: difficult or impossible to afford or understand
examples: The language of teenagers is often completely [[inaccessible]] to the elderly.
A long flight of stairs made the center of the museum [[inaccessible]] to disabled visitors.

senses.zh: 难到达的 ; 不可及的
senses.en: difficult or impossible to reach
examples: The language of teenagers is often completely [[inaccessible]] to the elderly.
A long flight of stairs made the center of the museum [[inaccessible]] to disabled visitors.

senses.en: treat a person or group differently from another in an unfair way
examples: Caulfield claimed the company had [[discriminated]] against him because of his nationality.

senses.zh: 年轻地；像年轻人地；具有年轻人特点地
senses.en: in a way that is similar to, typical of, or relates to young people
examples: Melania believes that dressing [[youthfully]] is about keeping up with trends.

senses.en: strong and healthy
examples: Cutting the bush back in the autumn will help promote [[vigorous]] growth in the spring.
According to a recent survey, a quarter of people over 12 get no [[vigorous]] exercise at all.

senses.en: using a lot of energy and strength or determination
examples: Cutting the bush back in the autumn will help promote [[vigorous]] growth in the spring.
According to a recent survey, a quarter of people over 12 get no [[vigorous]] exercise at all.

senses.en: having old-fashioned attitudes and ideas — used to show disapproval
examples: Tim was rude, unable to bear criticism, and more and more [[hidebound]] in his views as he got older.

senses.en: bring back the same feelings or qualities that you experienced in the past
examples: I would say the film successfully [[recaptured]] the joyful atmosphere of those days.

senses.en: a working life in which you have several different jobs at one time, or a series of different kinds of job
examples: There is a trend toward more temporary employment and [[portfolio]] careers.

senses.en: in a way that is suitable for a particular situation or that is based on what sb. has done or said
examples: It is said that the new employee has broken the rule and will be punished [[accordingly]].

senses.en: (BrE labourer) sb. whose work needs physical strength, for example building work
examples: Matthew has worked as a [[laborer]] in factories and on construction sites since he left his hometown.

senses.en: sb. whose job is to keep and check financial accounts, calculate taxes, etc.
examples: People setting up business on their own really need to employ an [[accountant]].

senses.en: the act of guessing about the possible causes or effects of sth. without knowing all the facts, or the guesses that you make
examples: There has been a great deal of [[speculation]] about what will happen after the president resigns.

senses.en: an unpleasant or difficult situation that is difficult to escape from
examples: Don't fall into the [[trap]] of investing all your money in one place.
Don't fall into the [[trap]] of investing all your money in one place.

senses.en: continuing forever and having no end
examples: Three teenage girls took a vow (誓言) of [[eternal]] friendship during the summer of 1985.

senses.en: (cause to) dry and die
examples: It is a pity that the spring flowers were already beginning to [[wither]].

senses.en: warn sb. that sth. might be dangerous, difficult, etc.
examples: The business report released on Wednesday [[cautioned]] investors against over-optimistic expectations.

senses.en: (infml.) very good, esp. in a way that makes you feel happy and excited
examples: The actress who played the fashion designer in the movie was absolutely [[terrific]]!

senses.en: force sth. into a small space
examples: You have to be realistic — it's difficult to [[cram]] everything into a tight schedule.

senses.en: succeed in dealing with a difficult problem or situation
examples: Some parents feel that they have got to the stage where they aren't able to [[cope]] on their own.

senses.zh: 不会长生不死的；终有一死的
senses.en: not able to live forever
examples: Her father's death reminded her that she was [[mortal]], and it made her very sad.

senses.en: the state of living forever or being remembered forever
examples: Some people want to achieve [[immortality]] through their works.

senses.zh: 幻想家；空想家；不切实际者
senses.en: sb. who often has fantasies, or who confuses fantasy and what is real
examples: He is neither a liar nor a [[fantasist]], and he is careful about what he says.

senses.en: a list of things that you want to do before you die
examples: Traveling to the Potala Palace in Tibet has been on my [[bucket]] list for years.

senses.en: manage to avoid death or a very bad situation even though it seemed that you would not be able to
examples: 逃脱厄运等

senses.en: no longer young, and therefore no longer attractive or good at doing things
examples: Kathleen thinks she's [[over]] the [[hill]], but she's only 32.

senses.zh: 可买到的； 供使用的；提供的
senses.en: available to be bought, chosen, or used
examples: Activities [[on]] [[offer]] at the beach include sailing, rowing, canoeing and camping.

senses.en: arriving or happening soon
examples: Economists agree that the economic situation is good and recovery is [[on]] the [[way]].

senses.en: (BrE be on the cards) seem likely to happen
examples: - So you think they'll get married next year? - I think it's in the [[cards]].

senses.en: become damaged and useless, or make sth. like this, by using it a lot or for a long time
examples: I bought a pair of boots three years ago and they are beginning to [[wear]] out.

senses.en: start a business
examples: Dr. Rosen closed his downtown practice and [[set]] up [[shop]] in a suburban neighborhood.

senses.zh: （某种品质、疾病、技能等）在家族中遗传，是家族特征
senses.en: if sth. such as a quality, disease, or skill runs in the family, many people in that family have it
examples: All the three kids of the Thompsons are good musicians. The musical talent seems to [[run]] in the [[family]].

senses.en: sb. who has the whip hand is in a good position because they can make other people do what they want
examples: During the last decade, the right wing of the party has held the [[whip]] [[hand]] over the country.

senses.zh: （尤指通过增加另一特点而）使更加完美，彻底完成
senses.en: make sth. more complete, esp. by adding another feature
examples: The feedback is that more research and solid evidence are needed to [[round]] out the article.

senses.en: prepare a written document, such as a list or contract
examples: Local authorities have [[drawn]] up guidelines on waste treatment and disposal.
